svg.title: The cadet room, five past ten
svg.desc: A newspaper training room with four versions of one paragraph pinned up, a whiteboard carrying one sentence eight times, a readers' survey and a fare-box diagram.

g.text: The cadet room, five past ten
Twelve things to find. Four of them say the same thing in four different orders.
the whiteboard: one sentence, eight times
the style guide, open at FIRST PARAGRAPH
a story with one line circled
the highlighter that has run out
Dennis - thirty-one years of taking those words out
the standfirst box, drawn in marker
the window, with the line visible
